sections.title: Meeting Context
content: Prep pack provides a structured framework for the discussion.

sections.title: Pre-Call Research Notes
fallback: Pre-call research on {expert_name} and {topic_area}. Check LinkedIn, institutional websites, and recent publications before the call.
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 3-4 sentences of pre-call research notes for an expert-call meeting. Suggest what to look up about the expert and the topic area.

subsections.title: Industry Landscape
questions: What is your assessment of the current industry landscape?
What are the major unmet needs or gaps you see?
How is the competitive set evolving?

subsections.title: Competitive Dynamics
questions: What emerging entrants or products concern you most?
What competitive advantages matter most in this space?
How do you rate the leaders vs. challengers today?

subsections.title: Commercial Outlook
questions: What are the key barriers to adoption or market access?
What drives adoption curves in your view?

subsections.title: Regulatory & Policy Environment
questions: What regulatory pathways or requirements are most relevant?
What approval or compliance timelines are realistic?
What policy changes would most impact this space?

sections.title: Key Hypotheses to Test
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 4-5 investment hypotheses to test with this expert. Each should be a short statement that the expert can validate or refute. Format as numbered statements.
